what_it_is: Womanly is a Brooklyn-based print magazine that delivers health information to women and non-binary people through art, photography, poetry and essays. Each issue takes one health theme (fatness in No. 8, grief in No. 9) and mixes personal narratives with contributions from artists and health professionals. It is for readers interested in community health, body politics and art-led publishing.
